a019cda395d540066481ce7063c636fd8f5e243a.tgt: Wrong. Yes, it has a base case: `n <= 1`.

a76768e485d8633e011c14f69c219e7f494827c5.src: Porque solo hace una llamada recursiva.
a76768e485d8633e011c14f69c219e7f494827c5.tgt: Because it only makes a recursive call.

59c48e2fc8d5264a2b44070faf90f7d032da02b8.src: Incorrecto. Hace dos llamadas recursivas, pero no de tamaño `n/2`.
59c48e2fc8d5264a2b44070faf90f7d032da02b8.tgt: Wrong. It makes two recursive calls, but not of size `n/2`.

df411f2c62650e25da0c9dd4c26c17ecc0c5c00d.src: Porque `Θ(1)` nunca puede aparecer en una recurrencia recursiva.
df411f2c62650e25da0c9dd4c26c17ecc0c5c00d.tgt: Because `Θ(1)` can never appear in a recursive recursion.

d2b108d705902d2bc1e576513f487d0c987f2ec2.src: Incorrecto. El trabajo adicional por llamada puede ser constante en muchas recurrencias.
d2b108d705902d2bc1e576513f487d0c987f2ec2.tgt: Wrong. Additional work per call can be constant in many recurrences.

6fa0e167a7ade6093e9fcc40ac27830c8eb9bbc7.src: ¿Qué significa que una recurrencia sea de Resta y Vencerás?
6fa0e167a7ade6093e9fcc40ac27830c8eb9bbc7.tgt: What does it mean for a recurrence to be Subtraction and Conquer?

9ed99f67ba119ff36d50846f82fa511b540e579a.src: En Resta y Vencerás, el tamaño del problema baja por una resta o reducción aditiva. Un ejemplo típico es `T(n)=T(n-1)+f(n)`.
9ed99f67ba119ff36d50846f82fa511b540e579a.tgt: In Subtraction and Conquer, the size of the problem is reduced by additive subtraction or reduction. A typical example is `T(n)=T(n-1)+f(n)`.

3ea2bd21a3ee76bfc9177e89cb497ea88005ddb7.src: Que el problema se reduce a uno o pocos subproblemas más pequeños por resta, como `n-1`, `n-2` o `n-c`.
3ea2bd21a3ee76bfc9177e89cb497ea88005ddb7.tgt: That the problem is reduced to one or a few smaller subproblems by subtraction, such as `n-1`, `n-2` or `n-c`.

2f04f008a1cf6fe8a94bcbcd69619aac3bc66d29.src: Correcto. La reducción ocurre quitando una cantidad del tamaño, no dividiendo balanceadamente en mitades.
2f04f008a1cf6fe8a94bcbcd69619aac3bc66d29.tgt: Correct. Reduction occurs by removing an amount from the size, not by dividing evenly into halves.

b4b6aad30318cfc3f380bf96f3d6e3eb2ef3427d.src: Que el problema se divide siempre en dos mitades exactas.
b4b6aad30318cfc3f380bf96f3d6e3eb2ef3427d.tgt: That the problem is always divided into two exact halves.

8e850dbc6df7860b4380133682b0a6637ae134cf.src: Incorrecto. Eso corresponde a un patrón típico de Divide y Vencerás, no de Resta y Vencerás.
8e850dbc6df7860b4380133682b0a6637ae134cf.tgt: Wrong. That corresponds to a typical Divide and Conquer pattern, not Subtraction and Conquer.

76c11c55981b3ae25c648a7867660d4bb7efd0a7.src: Que se usa una tabla para guardar todos los estados.
76c11c55981b3ae25c648a7867660d4bb7efd0a7.tgt: That a table is used to store all the states.

949b5583e33e1f62dde52849002d11f7f10572fd.src: Incorrecto. Eso describe una técnica asociada a Programación Dinámica, no la forma de la recurrencia.
949b5583e33e1f62dde52849002d11f7f10572fd.tgt: Wrong. That describes a technique associated with Dynamic Programming, not the form of recurrence.

ec78682752425a8d1b8efc01223d9e2948773c9e.src: Que el algoritmo no tiene caso base.
ec78682752425a8d1b8efc01223d9e2948773c9e.tgt: That the algorithm has no base case.

a9b3910c65355393f81ab55ce0dcabff00c5a30a.src: Incorrecto. Las recurrencias de Resta y Vencerás también necesitan caso base.
a9b3910c65355393f81ab55ce0dcabff00c5a30a.tgt: Wrong. Resta and Vencerás recurrences also need a base case.

e025b3a8ba463802c17901385afe65096c0d8ddb.src: ¿Qué significa que una recurrencia sea de Divide y Vencerás?
e025b3a8ba463802c17901385afe65096c0d8ddb.tgt: What does it mean for a recurrence to be Divide and Conquer?

aa987d719535ebbb6f14c08955c9d7651e279c26.src: Una forma típica es `T(n)=aT(n/b)+f(n)`, donde hay `a` subproblemas de tamaño aproximado `n/b` y un costo adicional de división o combinación.
aa987d719535ebbb6f14c08955c9d7651e279c26.tgt: A typical form is `T(n)=aT(n/b)+f(n)`, where there are `a` subproblems of approximate size `n/b` and an additional cost of splitting or combining.

882cc32d02e9baa6e03c992c41af4ff877299a30.src: Que el problema se divide en subproblemas más pequeños, normalmente independientes, y luego se combinan sus resultados.
882cc32d02e9baa6e03c992c41af4ff877299a30.tgt: That the problem is divided into smaller, usually independent, subproblems, and then their results are combined.

c2b7e481ba7bbb5a724249b57c267e9e2d29c986.src: Correcto. Divide y Vencerás tiene estructura de división, solución de subproblemas y combinación.
c2b7e481ba7bbb5a724249b57c267e9e2d29c986.tgt: Correct. Divide and Conquer has a division structure, subproblem solution and combination.

5b6ca41c282fc5a7d911b195c4ed4626c66b09e2.src: Que siempre se resta exactamente 1 al tamaño del problema.
5b6ca41c282fc5a7d911b195c4ed4626c66b09e2.tgt: Which always subtracts exactly 1 from the size of the problem.

dc926a36a9a0d4b02d99aa809e609326a6bfd2b8.src: Incorrecto. Restar 1 es típico de Resta y Vencerás, no de Divide y Vencerás balanceado.
dc926a36a9a0d4b02d99aa809e609326a6bfd2b8.tgt: Wrong. Subtracting 1 is typical of Subtract and Conquer, not balanced Divide and Conquer.

390dbc7a9437c651d7b29b86d905e6e9ea2b4c22.src: Que el algoritmo siempre es iterativo y no usa llamadas recursivas.
390dbc7a9437c651d7b29b86d905e6e9ea2b4c22.tgt: That the algorithm is always iterative and does not use recursive calls.

1c09d5fa5c3349a81488438381bc9a5bcb18c730.src: Incorrecto. Divide y Vencerás se expresa frecuentemente con recursión.
1c09d5fa5c3349a81488438381bc9a5bcb18c730.tgt: Wrong. Divide and Conquer is frequently expressed with recursion.

0271e481a617b767c773dd5bf6d76934ce8c4540.src: Incorrecto. El costo depende del número de subproblemas, sus tamaños y el costo de combinación.
0271e481a617b767c773dd5bf6d76934ce8c4540.tgt: Wrong. The cost depends on the number of subproblems, their sizes, and the combination cost.

e3e4718f1763c63c48496e0f572862844a78e792.src: ¿Qué significa que una recurrencia sea de Resta y Serás Vencido?
e3e4718f1763c63c48496e0f572862844a78e792.tgt: What does it mean for a recurrence to be Subtraction and You Will Be Defeated?

ad1c1e0947a62a81e9f16a6eeee64bfec2f9929f.src: La idea es que la recursión reduce poco el tamaño y además ramifica, por lo que el número de llamadas puede crecer muy rápido.
ad1c1e0947a62a81e9f16a6eeee64bfec2f9929f.tgt: The idea is that recursion reduces the size little and also branches, so the number of calls can grow very quickly.

5d453d57d41b2b70e64e90797aaa6d3da4a7e1a4.src: Que la reducción por resta genera una expansión costosa, normalmente con múltiples llamadas cercanas a `n`, como `T(n)=T(n-1)+T(n-2)+f(n)`.
5d453d57d41b2b70e64e90797aaa6d3da4a7e1a4.tgt: That reduction by subtraction leads to costly expansion, typically with multiple close calls to `n`, such as `T(n)=T(n-1)+T(n-2)+f(n)`.

dacb0906c18881d0a83cd03ada8d72a17dfdef8d.src: Correcto. La resta no reduce suficientemente el árbol de llamadas y puede producir crecimiento exponencial.
dacb0906c18881d0a83cd03ada8d72a17dfdef8d.tgt: Correct. Subtraction does not sufficiently reduce the call tree and can lead to exponential growth.

a318ac12c2db5828d5db0f583202004bfff61517.src: Que el algoritmo siempre tiene complejidad constante.
a318ac12c2db5828d5db0f583202004bfff61517.tgt: That the algorithm always has constant complexity.

4eb377851816f336253e176ad0e7cb64b2e1dd48.src: Incorrecto. Esta familia suele ser problemática precisamente por su crecimiento alto.
4eb377851816f336253e176ad0e7cb64b2e1dd48.tgt: Wrong. This family is usually problematic precisely because of its high growth.

3604bba44ef66791de06b6481f8ada36028d5f08.src: Que el problema se divide en subproblemas independientes de tamaño `n/2`.
3604bba44ef66791de06b6481f8ada36028d5f08.tgt: That the problem is divided into independent subproblems of size `n/2`.

7af6f0761116bc364ce57d67fbb150fe7676194b.src: Incorrecto. Eso describe una forma de Divide y Vencerás, no Resta y Serás Vencido.
7af6f0761116bc364ce57d67fbb150fe7676194b.tgt: Wrong. That describes a form of Divide and Conquer, not Subtract and Be Conquered.

61934dc2db8636e2199f94b068aee4063fe12cca.src: Que no puede escribirse ninguna recurrencia.
61934dc2db8636e2199f94b068aee4063fe12cca.tgt: That no recurrence can be written.

e0c85c0ff09febc36050c1c26d17f7ffac738e57.src: Incorrecto. Sí puede escribirse una recurrencia; el problema es que su expansión puede ser muy costosa.
e0c85c0ff09febc36050c1c26d17f7ffac738e57.tgt: Wrong. Yes, a recurrence can be written; The problem is that its expansion can be very expensive.

3e9e04d2c0657b22693a3c32b2fa737553434403.src: Dada la recurrencia `T(n)=T(n-1)+n`, ¿qué tipo de recurrencia es?
3e9e04d2c0657b22693a3c32b2fa737553434403.tgt: Given recurrence `T(n)=T(n-1)+n`, what type of recurrence is it?

ee8d926fb0a9bd94db42eae4c0fe7977a5ba5941.src: La forma `T(n)=T(n-1)+f(n)` es característica de una reducción aditiva con una sola llamada principal.
ee8d926fb0a9bd94db42eae4c0fe7977a5ba5941.tgt: The form `T(n)=T(n-1)+f(n)` is characteristic of an additive reduction with a single main call.

522e6ffc49c805c7027dab1f67169758417f73ef.src: Resta y Vencerás, porque se resuelve un subproblema de tamaño `n-1` y se agrega trabajo `n`.
522e6ffc49c805c7027dab1f67169758417f73ef.tgt: Subtract and Conquer, because a subproblem of size `n-1` is solved and work `n` is added.

71614de50d392fda9cc008b2dac7fd082ee42916.src: Correcto. El tamaño se reduce por resta y hay una sola llamada recursiva principal.
71614de50d392fda9cc008b2dac7fd082ee42916.tgt: Correct. The size is reduced by subtraction and there is a single main recursive call.

a32352cf19007f13489649026b652bf56663c9c2.src: Divide y Vencerás, porque aparece una suma.
a32352cf19007f13489649026b652bf56663c9c2.tgt: Divide and Conquer, because a sum appears.

c6184c66437c065d6a2821b89536ac60bacaf941.src: Incorrecto. La suma `+n` representa trabajo adicional, no división en subproblemas balanceados.
c6184c66437c065d6a2821b89536ac60bacaf941.tgt: Wrong. The sum `+n` represents additional work, not division into balanced subproblems.

20d5abf6176a6441e9ae18db9ebebba97ed357a4.src: Programación Dinámica, porque toda recurrencia usa una tabla.
20d5abf6176a6441e9ae18db9ebebba97ed357a4.tgt: Dynamic Programming, because all recurrence uses a table.

8304859d7634e13a6559d0b217d583be1a4fa253.src: Incorrecto. Una recurrencia no implica automáticamente tabla ni subproblemas superpuestos.
8304859d7634e13a6559d0b217d583be1a4fa253.tgt: Wrong. A recurrence does not automatically imply table or overlapping subproblems.

37db1c09272774031fb39f22e6fedc458fc357bf.src: Resta y Serás Vencido, porque tiene dos llamadas recursivas.
37db1c09272774031fb39f22e6fedc458fc357bf.tgt: Subtract and You Will Be Defeated, because it has two recursive calls.

3c973980d60298303f1a973c93097513894d808f.src: Incorrecto. La recurrencia solo tiene una llamada `T(n-1)`.
3c973980d60298303f1a973c93097513894d808f.tgt: Wrong. The recurrence only has one call `T(n-1)`.

cffaa05a50a054d71f36b459d62bf641301467b4.src: Dada la recurrencia `T(n)=2T(n/2)+n`, ¿qué tipo de recurrencia es?
cffaa05a50a054d71f36b459d62bf641301467b4.tgt: Given recurrence `T(n)=2T(n/2)+n`, what type of recurrence is it?

7d01d3754286180cd28361ca5df45af05bc2097e.src: `2T(n/2)` representa dos subproblemas balanceados. El término `+n` representa el trabajo de dividir o combinar en cada llamada.
7d01d3754286180cd28361ca5df45af05bc2097e.tgt: `2T(n/2)` represents two balanced subproblems. The term `+n` represents the work of splitting or combining on each call.

80118bcf4dddc645a4f520ba93ef300a53ddd1e2.src: Divide y Vencerás, porque hay dos subproblemas de tamaño `n/2` y trabajo adicional lineal.
80118bcf4dddc645a4f520ba93ef300a53ddd1e2.tgt: Divide and Conquer, because there are two subproblems of size `n/2` and additional linear work.

227055bb7d23da8f1cead3a806520fed8da8c404.src: Correcto. La forma coincide con división balanceada en subproblemas más pequeños.
227055bb7d23da8f1cead3a806520fed8da8c404.tgt: Correct. The form coincides with balanced division into smaller subproblems.

5b1ab9084a060975bc6c391c9fc3b3d976d08bd2.src: Resta y Vencerás, porque se resta una unidad en cada paso.
5b1ab9084a060975bc6c391c9fc3b3d976d08bd2.tgt: Subtract and Win, because one unit is subtracted in each step.

d57a4fc15b6fd88a47b054a1b283848f0227b22e.src: Incorrecto. El tamaño baja por división entre 2, no por resta de una constante.
d57a4fc15b6fd88a47b054a1b283848f0227b22e.tgt: Wrong. The size decreases by division by 2, not by subtraction of a constant.

c5e6097f8f7670d0998d4ef17bada62e830d4a39.src: Resta y Serás Vencido, porque tiene trabajo adicional `n`.
c5e6097f8f7670d0998d4ef17bada62e830d4a39.tgt: Subtract and You Will Be Defeated, because it has additional work `n`.

fdda67aee9681e9347b38c9227cea1f1227e3cdb.src: Incorrecto. El trabajo adicional no define por sí solo esa familia; aquí los subproblemas son balanceados.
fdda67aee9681e9347b38c9227cea1f1227e3cdb.tgt: Wrong. Extra work alone does not define that family; here the subproblems are balanced.

86dd13297fee8baf1537f4ea5a0d071328110f7b.src: Iterativa, porque la recurrencia contiene una suma.
86dd13297fee8baf1537f4ea5a0d071328110f7b.tgt: Iterative, because the recurrence contains a sum.

35858bc6d278c0de3782fe9836d29f0bfd1dafd8.src: Incorrecto. La presencia de `T(n/2)` indica estructura recursiva, no iterativa.
35858bc6d278c0de3782fe9836d29f0bfd1dafd8.tgt: Wrong. The presence of `T(n/2)` indicates recursive, not iterative, structure.

5946f0840915f8f61a12b91d516162fc41535520.src: Dada `T(n)=T(n-1)+T(n-2)+1`, ¿por qué se considera una recurrencia costosa o explosiva?
5946f0840915f8f61a12b91d516162fc41535520.tgt: Given `T(n)=T(n-1)+T(n-2)+1`, why is it considered a costly or explosive recurrence?

7b54fe9f25f4c50d876b962318ab383909a31ffc.src: La recurrencia casi conserva el tamaño en cada rama y además duplica parcialmente el trabajo. Ese patrón produce un árbol de llamadas muy grande.
7b54fe9f25f4c50d876b962318ab383909a31ffc.tgt: Recurrence almost preserves the size on each branch and also partially doubles the work. That pattern produces a very large call tree.

d24c8409d6f65cd54f9cab05d2f8147dcbc04833.src: Porque genera dos ramas recursivas que reducen poco el tamaño, produciendo un árbol de llamadas grande.
d24c8409d6f65cd54f9cab05d2f8147dcbc04833.tgt: Because it generates two recursive branches that reduce the size a little, producing a large call tree.

e29cec33be43a3276b4348081bdd166a987ddf55.src: Correcto. La reducción por resta y la ramificación hacen que el número de llamadas crezca rápidamente.
e29cec33be43a3276b4348081bdd166a987ddf55.tgt: Correct. Subtraction reduction and branching cause the number of calls to grow rapidly.

310c77e4d1b92a54e82e988ae6eaa8cfa192ad3d.src: Porque tiene trabajo constante `+1`, y todo trabajo constante produce crecimiento exponencial.
310c77e4d1b92a54e82e988ae6eaa8cfa192ad3d.tgt: Because it has constant work `+1`, and all constant work produces exponential growth.

431d9f8735ee9021b115a319059eb594eeaf0c78.src: Incorrecto. El problema no es el `+1`; es la ramificación recursiva con reducción lenta.
431d9f8735ee9021b115a319059eb594eeaf0c78.tgt: Wrong. The problem is not the `+1`; is recursive branching with slow reduction.

ac63190d67fa50231461131d7d97838625bc35d5.src: Porque divide el problema exactamente en dos mitades.
ac63190d67fa50231461131d7d97838625bc35d5.tgt: Because it divides the problem exactly into two halves.

cd4ebae49eafac1317817be6aeb5192a2704d9a5.src: Incorrecto. No divide en mitades; reduce a `n-1` y `n-2`.
cd4ebae49eafac1317817be6aeb5192a2704d9a5.tgt: Wrong. It does not divide into halves; reduces to `n-1` and `n-2`.

dfdd4f2b990bea906803d5db6768a102c6aca3c6.tgt: Because it doesn't have recursive calls.

7ab534ee4c46a9d00e753ce297f877a4aac45f22.src: Incorrecto. Tiene dos llamadas recursivas explícitas.
7ab534ee4c46a9d00e753ce297f877a4aac45f22.tgt: Wrong. It has two explicit recursive calls.

7aec108f2f7c12ef0a0fef518d0f9b84822a1194.src: ¿Qué error comete alguien que cuenta solo la profundidad recursiva e ignora el número de ramas?
7aec108f2f7c12ef0a0fef518d0f9b84822a1194.tgt: What mistake does someone make who counts only the recursive depth and ignores the number of branches?

742ad9c0d722ee56b3ca77f5eab5d823a9f5280f.src: El costo recursivo no depende solo de cuántos niveles tiene el árbol, sino de cuántas llamadas hay por nivel y cuánto cuesta cada llamada.
742ad9c0d722ee56b3ca77f5eab5d823a9f5280f.tgt: The recursive cost depends not only on how many levels the tree has, but on how many calls there are per level and how much each call costs.

5ede0d256e8612ea3a891c4301761f4486996c46.src: Puede subestimar el costo total, porque muchas ramas pueden existir en el mismo nivel del árbol de llamadas.
5ede0d256e8612ea3a891c4301761f4486996c46.tgt: You may underestimate the total cost, because many branches may exist at the same level of the call tree.

c85e03464e57677b6ad32c77cad6a026164c2e0a.src: Correcto. La profundidad mide niveles, pero el costo total también depende de cuántos nodos hay en cada nivel.
c85e03464e57677b6ad32c77cad6a026164c2e0a.tgt: Correct. Depth measures levels, but the total cost also depends on how many nodes there are in each level.

acf201d37dd37b994ffe0319fad2bde77c8711fd.src: No comete ningún error; la profundidad siempre determina todo el costo.
acf201d37dd37b994ffe0319fad2bde77c8711fd.tgt: He doesn't make any mistakes; The depth always determines the entire cost.

c0ef86cad084b5078986abdef96c3a0c94faa23d.src: Incorrecto. Dos recurrencias pueden tener la misma profundidad y cantidades de ramas muy distintas.
c0ef86cad084b5078986abdef96c3a0c94faa23d.tgt: Wrong. Two recurrences can have the same depth and very different numbers of branches.

3dc7e453775eccd8976a952f1074c96ef9776995.src: Sobrestima siempre el costo, porque las ramas no cuentan.
3dc7e453775eccd8976a952f1074c96ef9776995.tgt: Always overestimate the cost, because branches don't count.

99e954693c59f37733cb33970569b5f5bca524f7.src: Incorrecto. Las ramas sí cuentan: cada llamada representa trabajo.
99e954693c59f37733cb33970569b5f5bca524f7.tgt: Wrong. Branches do count: each call represents work.

49d3116316a7c26774c9362bb1760f9a02b9c542.src: Incorrecto. El problema es una mala estimación del árbol recursivo, no un cambio de técnica.
49d3116316a7c26774c9362bb1760f9a02b9c542.tgt: Wrong. The problem is poor estimation of the recursive tree, not a change in technique.

886a78eccf3e1f0df5f8b50bb0afcac206812b41.src: ¿Qué error comete alguien que plantea `T(n)=T(n-1)` para un algoritmo que además hace un ciclo de `n` operaciones antes de llamar recursivamente?
886a78eccf3e1f0df5f8b50bb0afcac206812b41.tgt: What mistake does someone make who raises `T(n)=T(n-1)` for an algorithm that also loops `n` operations before calling recursively?

d999b1bbebea491825d397a6b9510951843a18ce.src: Si cada llamada hace un ciclo de `n` operaciones y luego llama a tamaño `n-1`, la forma debería parecerse a `T(n)=T(n-1)+Θ(n)`.
d999b1bbebea491825d397a6b9510951843a18ce.tgt: If each call loops `n` operations and then calls size `n-1`, the shape should look like `T(n)=T(n-1)+Θ(n)`.

d030fa6d072ba670c94f725956c66b7322124c30.src: Está omitiendo el trabajo no recursivo de cada llamada, que debería aparecer como un término adicional.
d030fa6d072ba670c94f725956c66b7322124c30.tgt: You are skipping the non-recursive work of each call, which should appear as an additional term.

1da698960448a5b16ac7dbc5becb9e3f9ff2dbb6.src: Correcto. La recurrencia debe incluir tanto las llamadas recursivas como el trabajo local.
1da698960448a5b16ac7dbc5becb9e3f9ff2dbb6.tgt: Correct. Recursion must include both recursive calls and local work.

4fad877595c7efd0f34feed6b72dbef95d5184ea.src: Está agregando demasiado trabajo no recursivo.
4fad877595c7efd0f34feed6b72dbef95d5184ea.tgt: You are adding too much non-recursive work.

9bb646f999126f8cd435e27ab2684621d26317de.src: Incorrecto. En realidad lo está omitiendo.

74ab918f76b5e6d29057fb6d503b2849c4cf9acc.tgt: You are using a recurrence, and recurrences cannot have cycles.

a5a46aba486d5ace87be3559d53b118398ca9e68.src: Una recurrencia temporal resume llamadas recursivas, tamaño de subproblemas y costo local no recursivo. Esas tres piezas son indispensables.
a5a46aba486d5ace87be3559d53b118398ca9e68.tgt: A temporal recurrence summarizes recursive calls, subproblem size, and non-recursive local cost. Those three pieces are essential.

f172d8556004eeab065ae9dc955de55a69660903.src: ¿Cuántas llamadas recursivas se hacen en el caso general?
f172d8556004eeab065ae9dc955de55a69660903.tgt: How many recursive calls are made in the general case?

394aeea66c47783b59f38ca081e2fef8622feb92.src: Correcto. El número de llamadas determina cuántos términos recursivos aparecen.
394aeea66c47783b59f38ca081e2fef8622feb92.tgt: Correct. The number of calls determines how many recursive terms appear.

d6b4fe6916f27129d7a82af3ac2ccc0066c2e367.src: Correcto. No es lo mismo llamar a `n-1`, a `n/2` o a tamaños irregulares.
d6b4fe6916f27129d7a82af3ac2ccc0066c2e367.tgt: Correct. It is not the same to call `n-1`, `n/2` or irregular sizes.

66e7cc2282a449692f77926f3d5922f6da67e5ef.tgt: Correct. Recurrence must include the local cost of splitting, combining, traversing, or comparing.

dd1a3970225da4859e5e687be2f7cfc1d476534a.tgt: Wrong. The appearance of the editor does not affect mathematical recurrence.

5018ec6f9fbf7a84bf6ad914a21d02b6f6ced372.tgt: Why should the cost of combining subproblems appear explicitly in a recurrence?

09d8820fd3498fb1435560f274939455782fa4eb.src: Una recurrencia incompleta puede subestimar el costo. En `T(n)=aT(n/b)+f(n)`, el término `f(n)` representa justamente el trabajo no recursivo.
09d8820fd3498fb1435560f274939455782fa4eb.tgt: An incomplete recurrence may underestimate the cost. In `T(n)=aT(n/b)+f(n)`, the term `f(n)` represents precisely the non-recursive work.

770bd67a9a18dfbd6f967e51d43942009d07c796.src: Porque resolver los subproblemas no incluye automáticamente el trabajo de unir, comparar o procesar sus resultados.
770bd67a9a18dfbd6f967e51d43942009d07c796.tgt: Because solving subproblems does not automatically include the work of joining, comparing or processing their results.

9d9ed7d260620bdbb19b6880f26214a57ba95cfb.tgt: Correct. Recursion must add the recursive work and the local combination or processing work.

a2aaa3d4dd565297758db573ddda24c5e74c364e.src: Incorrecto. El costo de combinar depende del algoritmo: puede ser constante, lineal, cuadrático u otro.
a2aaa3d4dd565297758db573ddda24c5e74c364e.tgt: Wrong. The cost of combining depends on the algorithm: it can be constant, linear, quadratic or other.

dbb98ff66e3e1480f9ef718d0e4223a885e035a1.tgt: Wrong. Each algorithm combines differently, and that cost changes the recurrence.

7595826202be111834f4f961feec8331620d4739.tgt: What does it mean to resolve a recurrence in the context of algorithm analysis?

c9b2c09943c30937cb61d6d01a4c3f5d821ac796.src: La recurrencia define `T(n)` en términos de tamaños menores. Resolverla significa describir el crecimiento de `T(n)` sin depender indefinidamente de llamadas recursivas.
c9b2c09943c30937cb61d6d01a4c3f5d821ac796.tgt: Recurrence defines `T(n)` in terms of smaller sizes. Solving it means describing the growth of `T(n)` without relying indefinitely on recursive calls.

adcc9654a9a24cc7c197ce9b5533576b524279f9.src: Obtener una expresión cerrada o una cota asintótica que describa el crecimiento de `T(n)`.
adcc9654a9a24cc7c197ce9b5533576b524279f9.tgt: Obtain a closed expression or an asymptotic bound that describes the growth of `T(n)`.

52cc6197fb5162492e2f1ac0b1d8ab3449d3afcd.tgt: Correct. Resolving a recurrence allows us to move from a recursive definition of cost to interpretable complexity.

e1bc3bbb4d97fae5a8cb1003893d82074c1b582a.tgt: Wrong. That would be empirical measurement, not mathematical resolution of recurrence.

d7d7aff83e2b223c04b31c6cd49de0412d23d180.tgt: Wrong. Resolving the recurrence does not change the code; analyze its cost.

d15588f5b3c3e35733a0d782236c6fb4d36a8049.tgt: Convert any recursive algorithm into a greedy algorithm.

d4b780e238f6cdcf69278786bbc35322fed7725e.tgt: ¿Por qué dos algoritmos recursivos pueden tener la misma profundidad pero complejidades distintas?

f4704c1cae1189c0878c29c534c5f7d6685ff18d.tgt: For example, a recursion with one call per level and another with two calls per level may have similar heights, but very different call trees.

27a9d49ff93f5fd496c82f5ed32c20da8b2bb7da.tgt: Because they may have a different number of calls per level or a different local cost for each call.

200e22a98b92751879650b304295069258be0622.tgt: Correct. Depth is not enough; Branching and non-recursive work also matter.

520678dca5c3e69bf0b549ab706aedb635c50bdb.tgt: Wrong. Depth can influence, but it is not the only factor.

56433f3137dd050113170c810022b9eb733bf2e4.tgt: Because recursive complexities are chosen by intuition and not by counting.

29c073ac3e34c9c70faf5630f021c02473e90aa8.tgt: Wrong. That expression does not model recursive calls or additional linear work.

1e281728fb26ea53d53681023970d56008a61c1b.src: Iterar una recurrencia significa reemplazar `T` por su propia definición varias veces, identificar el patrón general, calcular cuándo se alcanza el caso base y simplificar la suma resultante.
1e281728fb26ea53d53681023970d56008a61c1b.tgt: Iterating a recurrence means replacing `T` with your own definition several times, identifying the general pattern, calculating when the base case is reached, and simplifying the resulting sum.

83800bcee1413f195b3c448b83dca35739e6a527.src: Expandir repetidamente la recurrencia hasta reconocer un patrón, llegar al caso base y sumar el trabajo acumulado.
83800bcee1413f195b3c448b83dca35739e6a527.tgt: Repeatedly expand the recurrence until you recognize a pattern, reach the base case, and add up the accumulated work.

73a438d09d8cbbc0b1a5ce8f6262467d8b4e5048.tgt: The expansion is `T(n)=T(n-1)+1 = T(n-2)+2 = T(n-3)+3`. The general pattern is `T(n)=T(n-k)+k`.

d82294479682ba4c23cb3499866c3bcb5da6c1cc.tgt: Correct. Each expansion reduces the argument by 1 and adds 1 to the accumulated cost.

832f28b0f2c35bf95587f8b8f6d306625e1a282f.src: Correcto. Después de `k` expansiones el argumento es `n-k`; para llegar a `T(1)` se requiere `k=n-1`.

2f91e2477b8f35b0d867ab85e00117c811caebb9.src: Permanece en `n` por nivel: `2^i` subproblemas de tamaño `n/2^i` aportan `2^i·(n/2^i)=n`.
2f91e2477b8f35b0d867ab85e00117c811caebb9.tgt: It remains at `n` per level: `2^i` subproblems of size `n/2^i` contribute `2^i·(n/2^i)=n`.

05f51cf4bc4ce3c07fd1d710c3f4de15a3aafecf.src: Correcto. En esta recurrencia, todos los niveles internos tienen trabajo total lineal.
05f51cf4bc4ce3c07fd1d710c3f4de15a3aafecf.tgt: Correct. In this recurrence, all internal levels have total linear work.

5b2e288f8ae8b11e97ab0b83edc4bcbfe6df60fa.src: Se reduce a la mitad en cada nivel: `n`, `n/2`, `n/4`, etc.

c97637739d73d0959886662faa3ca21e94788995.src: Incorrecto. Eso ocurriría con una sola llamada `T(n/2)+n`; aquí hay dos llamadas que compensan la reducción.
c97637739d73d0959886662faa3ca21e94788995.tgt: Wrong. That would happen with a single `T(n/2)+n` call; here are two calls that offset the reduction.

6afe2357586702781ff91b0c08a68683f1ad8275.src: Incorrecto. El trabajo por nivel sigue siendo `n` hasta llegar a hojas.
6afe2357586702781ff91b0c08a68683f1ad8275.tgt: Wrong. The work per level continues to be `n` until reaching sheets.

4e0b49c60cc940fa2cbc2677c94fe2a21222ddcd.src: Se vuelve cuadrático en cada nivel.
4e0b49c60cc940fa2cbc2677c94fe2a21222ddcd.tgt: It becomes quadratic at each level.

cd9f06abf67537e31eb91ad0240d85faffde499f.src: Incorrecto. El costo por nivel es lineal, no cuadrático.
cd9f06abf67537e31eb91ad0240d85faffde499f.tgt: Wrong. The cost per level is linear, not quadratic.

b703b9e51e0e73e5a409f49bdfe7412fcd653a36.src: En el método de iteración, ¿qué representa el índice `k` en una expansión como `T(n)=T(n/2^k)+...`?
b703b9e51e0e73e5a409f49bdfe7412fcd653a36.tgt: In the iteration method, what does the index `k` represent in an expansion like `T(n)=T(n/2^k)+...`?

9b0e6d7d99c873e7255d4cba632cf0c62ec5bb6d.src: `k` permite escribir el patrón general después de varias expansiones. Luego se despeja usando la condición de caso base.
9b0e6d7d99c873e7255d4cba632cf0c62ec5bb6d.tgt: `k` allows the general pattern to be written after several expansions. It is then solved using the base case condition.

7382afdda6da94106ce08d4ef1c21f6c518c0dc3.src: El número de expansiones realizadas o niveles recorridos hasta ese momento.
7382afdda6da94106ce08d4ef1c21f6c518c0dc3.tgt: The number of expansions made or levels completed up to that point.

223d888bb8ba5823912ab2ff6538a3f26ee65f1c.src: Correcto. `k` cuenta cuántas veces se ha sustituido la recurrencia por su definición.
223d888bb8ba5823912ab2ff6538a3f26ee65f1c.tgt: Correct. `k` counts how many times recurrence has been replaced by its definition.

18a68db6b738403d674d4ea64c9b5ce645243ec1.src: El tamaño original de la entrada.
18a68db6b738403d674d4ea64c9b5ce645243ec1.tgt: The original size of the entry.

0a35663a0e29a46cfdf3aaaff66511cb99eea257.src: Incorrecto. El tamaño original suele ser `n`; `k` cuenta expansiones.
0a35663a0e29a46cfdf3aaaff66511cb99eea257.tgt: Wrong. The original size is usually `n`; `k` counts expansions.

cc52e4cfbe9fd03cded9962c48b8081e640454b3.src: El costo constante de cada operación elemental.
cc52e4cfbe9fd03cded9962c48b8081e640454b3.tgt: The constant cost of each elementary operation.

e90b45eb9931dc79e95ee995fd8d24c60016c5f2.src: Incorrecto. `k` no es una constante de costo; es un contador de expansión.
e90b45eb9931dc79e95ee995fd8d24c60016c5f2.tgt: Wrong. `k` is not a cost constant; It is an expansion counter.

842b359f2cb84b7687f5a80dd67f7e8eca63205c.src: El número de algoritmos distintos que se comparan.
842b359f2cb84b7687f5a80dd67f7e8eca63205c.tgt: The number of different algorithms that are compared.

1e4cb18dcfff29d383e563a5ed165e8b288b2bb3.src: Incorrecto. `k` pertenece al desarrollo de una sola recurrencia.
1e4cb18dcfff29d383e563a5ed165e8b288b2bb3.tgt: Wrong. `k` belongs to the development of a single recurrence.

a10601d26ccc6ed807d5ca51ba0d3c42d707566d.src: Para una recurrencia cuyo tamaño tras `k` expansiones es `n/2^k`, ¿cómo se obtiene `k` cuando el subproblema llega a tamaño 1?
a10601d26ccc6ed807d5ca51ba0d3c42d707566d.tgt: For a recurrence whose size after `k` expansions is `n/2^k`, how is `k` obtained when the subproblem reaches size 1?

a033991ef101ce6c2bd53a947cc8587d2b8543b6.src: El caso base se usa como ecuación de parada. Si el tamaño es `n/2^k`, llegar a 1 exige `n/2^k=1`, por tanto `k=log₂ n`.
a033991ef101ce6c2bd53a947cc8587d2b8543b6.tgt: The base case is used as the stopping equation. If the size is `n/2^k`, reaching 1 requires `n/2^k=1`, therefore `k=log₂ n`.

9ddc4625e397dbd00b600d484bf1e85b29136441.src: Se resuelve `n/2^k=1`, de donde `2^k=n` y `k=log₂ n`.

e604b6e1d6ebb7a2284ca62c0c30e1809148fa42.src: Correcto. Esa ecuación conecta el patrón de reducción con la cantidad de niveles.
e604b6e1d6ebb7a2284ca62c0c30e1809148fa42.tgt: Correct. That equation connects the reduction pattern to the number of levels.

de379b08e30ff32ecb8f740e48f755a6a8bad0ce.src: Incorrecto. `n-k=1` corresponde a reducción por resta de 1, no por división entre 2.
de379b08e30ff32ecb8f740e48f755a6a8bad0ce.tgt: Wrong. `n-k=1` corresponds to reduction by subtraction of 1, not by division by 2.

03a273ad8f0b2439cf8643f2b9d2657acf1e6423.src: Se toma siempre `k=2` porque el divisor es 2.
03a273ad8f0b2439cf8643f2b9d2657acf1e6423.tgt: `k=2` is always taken because the divisor is 2.

998989fe19c190c2c286fe5e7e1515d631ab1601.src: Incorrecto. El divisor 2 no significa que solo haya dos expansiones.
998989fe19c190c2c286fe5e7e1515d631ab1601.tgt: Wrong. Divider 2 does not mean that there are only two expansions.

ffd614f428234c0832d21261ace24cd3b37b636d.src: No se puede obtener `k` porque las recurrencias no tienen punto de parada.
ffd614f428234c0832d21261ace24cd3b37b636d.tgt: `k` cannot be obtained because recurrences have no stopping point.

67711b9d70e82fbadc2a5e030f426959845cd8f9.src: Incorrecto. Si existe caso base, justamente se usa para despejar el número de expansiones.
67711b9d70e82fbadc2a5e030f426959845cd8f9.tgt: Wrong. If a base case exists, it is precisely used to solve for the number of expansions.

2d3a2aabdd8431b7d50a35751d12926b134f6f80.src: Dada `T(n)=T(n/3)+n`, ¿cuántas iteraciones se necesitan hasta llegar a `T(1)`?
2d3a2aabdd8431b7d50a35751d12926b134f6f80.tgt: Given `T(n)=T(n/3)+n`, how many iterations are needed to reach `T(1)`?

8c3e337b68b71b4e8895746458d384c4fa72bed8.src: Tras `k` expansiones queda `T(n/3^k)`. Para llegar a `T(1)`, se resuelve `n/3^k=1`, así que `k=log₃ n`.
8c3e337b68b71b4e8895746458d384c4fa72bed8.tgt: After `k` expansions, `T(n/3^k)` remains. To get to `T(1)`, we solve for `n/3^k=1`, so `k=log₃ n`.

7227c05b4d1bdf9b390813e1942e859efa8f8a03.src: Correcto. Después de `k` expansiones el tamaño es `n/3^k`; se llega a 1 cuando `3^k=n`.
7227c05b4d1bdf9b390813e1942e859efa8f8a03.tgt: Correct. After `k` expansions the size is `n/3^k`; 1 is reached when `3^k=n`.

e0bd001c28cd189679b14abee2f828f30440ee6d.src: Incorrecto. Dividir repetidamente por 3 produce una cantidad logarítmica de pasos, no lineal.
e0bd001c28cd189679b14abee2f828f30440ee6d.tgt: Wrong. Repeatedly dividing by 3 produces a logarithmic number of steps, not a linear one.

2abbaff74e35d6746e453649c0ba981e8802031c.src: Incorrecto. El 3 es factor de reducción, no multiplicador del número de expansiones.
2abbaff74e35d6746e453649c0ba981e8802031c.tgt: Wrong. The 3 is a reduction factor, not a multiplier of the number of expansions.

7ddb8bfc3f9a91813b5f24318f07ee61b7803e51.src: Incorrecto. `n-1` corresponde a una reducción por resta de 1, no por división entre 3.
7ddb8bfc3f9a91813b5f24318f07ee61b7803e51.tgt: Wrong. `n-1` corresponds to a reduction by subtraction of 1, not by division by 3.

ec8a752d5601b9d66b51ebd514495606a2c301d5.src: Resuelve por iteración `T(n)=T(n/3)+n`. ¿Cuál es el orden ajustado?
ec8a752d5601b9d66b51ebd514495606a2c301d5.tgt: Solve by iteration `T(n)=T(n/3)+n`. What is the adjusted order?

d92a5f1ee912d6cb2e6cbb6f13d13b1fa683c2a8.src: `T(n)=T(1)+n+n/3+n/9+...`. Esa serie geométrica suma una cantidad proporcional a `n`, por tanto `T(n) ∈ Θ(n)`.
d92a5f1ee912d6cb2e6cbb6f13d13b1fa683c2a8.tgt: `T(n)=T(1)+n+n/3+n/9+...`. This geometric series adds a quantity proportional to `n`, therefore `T(n) ∈ Θ(n)`.

9bb27de80bbb770c21386341b5c0e6742e06af39.src: Correcto. La expansión produce `n+n/3+n/9+...`, una serie geométrica decreciente dominada por `n`.
9bb27de80bbb770c21386341b5c0e6742e06af39.tgt: Correct. The expansion produces `n+n/3+n/9+...`, a decreasing geometric series dominated by `n`.

3b79443f5edd36daa9ffd0b11016e928d3f8b7df.src: Incorrecto. Aunque hay `log₃ n` niveles, el trabajo acumulado por la serie geométrica es lineal.
3b79443f5edd36daa9ffd0b11016e928d3f8b7df.tgt: Wrong. Although there are `log₃ n` levels, the work accumulated by the geometric series is linear.

b6b6717d43e5586660e92b29d26819d40d5e37aa.src: Incorrecto. El trabajo por nivel no se mantiene en `n`; disminuye por factor 3.
b6b6717d43e5586660e92b29d26819d40d5e37aa.tgt: Wrong. Work per level is not maintained at `n`; decreases by factor 3.

3247b1637cbfdb2be4fb502994cb2f54698ade8f.src: Incorrecto. No hay suma aritmética ni ciclos anidados; la serie es geométrica decreciente.
3247b1637cbfdb2be4fb502994cb2f54698ade8f.tgt: Wrong. There is no arithmetic addition or nested cycles; The series is decreasing geometric.

5b4cb52689d44003ba446d0b9c4d3b0eefdbbf9a.src: Dada `T(n)=T(n-1)+log n`, ¿qué sumatoria aparece al expandir hasta `T(1)`?
5b4cb52689d44003ba446d0b9c4d3b0eefdbbf9a.tgt: Given `T(n)=T(n-1)+log n`, what sum appears when expanding to `T(1)`?

8c981c3e563384ade2279c72fca88e4b9585ac15.src: La expansión produce `log n + log(n-1) + ... + log 2`, que se escribe como `∑_{i=2}^{n} log i`.
8c981c3e563384ade2279c72fca88e4b9585ac15.tgt: The expansion produces `log n + log(n-1) + ... + log 2`, which is written as `∑_{i=2}^{n} log i`.

556a6a715b5c7e28b7333b16d2df9b3e82c80e6b.src: Correcto. Cada expansión agrega el logaritmo del tamaño actual: `log n`, `log(n-1)`, etc.
556a6a715b5c7e28b7333b16d2df9b3e82c80e6b.tgt: Correct. Each expansion adds the logarithm of the current size: `log n`, `log(n-1)`, etc.

052bc5c0dfd50f57afb7ff7bc460b494ef723873.src: Incorrecto. El término agregado es logarítmico, no lineal.
052bc5c0dfd50f57afb7ff7bc460b494ef723873.tgt: Wrong. The aggregate term is logarithmic, not linear.

f6151ff350a4a1627ef197cfbbfc4891fc1172cc.src: Incorrecto. No se agrega solo una vez; se acumulan logaritmos durante muchas expansiones.
f6151ff350a4a1627ef197cfbbfc4891fc1172cc.tgt: Wrong. No se agrega solo una vez; logarithms accumulate over many expansions.

8a370a6bfe4b92dbed48154e6994c11528b42765.tgt: Wrong. Recursion reduces by `n-1`, it does not transform the argument into `log n`.

5897c9b3bd7b842806ac9635dc64ae64f8a4ccf7.tgt: `T(n)=T(1)+∑_{i=2}^{n} log i = T(1)+log(n!)`. Asymptotically, `log(n!) ∈ Θ(n log n)`.

ecd79341199d198485632df840bd30987c8e4bb4.tgt: Correct. Expansion produces `∑ log i = log(n!)`, whose growth is `Θ(n log n)`.

8dfcdfde91e216c1a9752a05611394357782662e.tgt: Wrong. Many logarithmic terms accumulate, not just one.

7ea71ea8dd94c71fdd3597fbe2fdeedefe2cca1c.tgt: Wrong. The sum of logarithms grows more than linear.

c83aa9b9a93fb73a79d405a1a2e6db7947835d4b.src: Dada `T(n)=T(n-1)+n²`, ¿qué orden asintótico se obtiene al expandir?

3c88624eaee2ebfbeabea42c721f76bf8677e183.src: `T(n)=T(1)+∑_{i=2}^{n} i²`. Como `∑ i² ∈ Θ(n³)`, el orden ajustado es `Θ(n³)`.
3c88624eaee2ebfbeabea42c721f76bf8677e183.tgt: `T(n)=T(1)+∑_{i=2}^{n} i²`. Like `∑ i² ∈ Θ(n³)`, the adjusted order is `Θ(n³)`.

8f4dbb46ed17675fd0a3853bf8bcb54a9e78d34f.src: Correcto. La expansión produce `∑_{i=1}^{n} i²`, cuya suma es cúbica.
8f4dbb46ed17675fd0a3853bf8bcb54a9e78d34f.tgt: Correct. The expansion produces `∑_{i=1}^{n} i²`, whose sum is cubic.

50b688154e2fdd561f641559723dff78ab3ab091.tgt: Wrong. Not a single `n²` term appears; squares of many sizes accumulate.

ad88563a98a453f839645efc2c75725a17699b3b.tgt: Wrong. This recurrence reduces by subtraction and accumulates squares, not logarithms.

db29abbd5343c5fd95daa4d7ae48797f9a04af51.src: Incorrecto. No hay división del tamaño ni número logarítmico de niveles.
db29abbd5343c5fd95daa4d7ae48797f9a04af51.tgt: Wrong. There is no size division or logarithmic number of levels.

294a69de2165d469b8204f91417c4b48e21a0b82.tgt: What error is made when stopping an expansion at `T(0)` when the base case defined was `T(1)`?

15174f3ebabaf4cca154530bfc4e40ef076b1196.tgt: The base case indicates where the recurrence stops expanding. Using an undefined stopping point can produce an invalid derivation even if the final order appears correct.

6dcc2629cf3e22ec78c8dc1bde6aa2f48ba3d836.src: Se usa un punto de parada que no corresponde a la recurrencia definida, lo que puede alterar la expresión exacta aunque a veces no cambie el orden asintótico.
6dcc2629cf3e22ec78c8dc1bde6aa2f48ba3d836.tgt: A stopping point is used that does not correspond to the defined recurrence, which can alter the exact expression although sometimes it does not change the asymptotic order.

1989e3ac5465175c0ab4a14b3d43590d93ab2fc4.tgt: Correct. The base case is not decorative; defines where expansion should stop.

da2bf868d72a5da62f74c1429cc9605ba4ec0282.src: No se comete ningún error, porque todos los casos base son intercambiables.
da2bf868d72a5da62f74c1429cc9605ba4ec0282.tgt: No mistakes are made, because all base cases are interchangeable.

8a575a614a14650a2ed680978211c213f447c97a.tgt: Wrong. Base cases are not interchangeable if an exact solution is being developed.

6b422b4475080895d2058441194fadf13ce7ed3b.tgt: Wrong. The error may not change the asymptotic order, but it is a poor mathematical justification.

c97cc538d66f9ce7610606b2960339ba721dbdb1.tgt: The iteration method ceases to exist if the base case is `T(1)`.

9b83810f694b8cbf6f305df430e1bc2c3c68c3c3.tgt: Wrong. The method works perfectly with `T(1)`; You just have to stop at the right point.

aa81ba92fda58ff97d068713e7c10477bb6d5450.tgt: Order the main steps of the iteration method to resolve a recurrence.

6cb9c034631a37f8f0de4c603a0e756490a10b8b.tgt: The iteration method follows a clear sequence: expansion, pattern, stopping point and simplification. Skipping any of these steps usually produces errors.

957cdd522877091cb01725f551ebfada4cb44e29.tgt: Recurrence is first replaced by its own definition to observe how the cost accumulates.

0dabe055f992044077326ddcb38e161ca2aa8e38.tgt: The expansion is then expressed in terms of `k`, the number of steps.

7a162192957b8721a4f16a143cbba9305d05107c.src: Usar el caso base para calcular el valor de `k`.
7a162192957b8721a4f16a143cbba9305d05107c.tgt: Use the base case to calculate the value of `k`.

3cd0738c3aef1af4b54a3de1bfcdc77838ffdc82.src: Después se despeja cuántas expansiones se necesitan para llegar al caso base.
3cd0738c3aef1af4b54a3de1bfcdc77838ffdc82.tgt: Then we solve for how many expansions are needed to reach the base case.

c00bd7456a857b758a3acf9ad6d07f8ba539fa96.src: Sustituir `k`, simplificar la suma y concluir el orden asintótico.
c00bd7456a857b758a3acf9ad6d07f8ba539fa96.tgt: Substitute `k`, simplify the sum and conclude the asymptotic order.

fc022dcae70e3c767f9bd92da53994c6f949bd75.src: Al final se reemplaza `k` y se simplifica la expresión acumulada.
fc022dcae70e3c767f9bd92da53994c6f949bd75.tgt: In the end `k` is replaced and the cumulative expression is simplified.

d6c12e10eed3e05410156afa7e9e814e2dc7b879.src: Resuelve por iteración `T(n)=T(n/2)+n²`. ¿Cuál es el orden ajustado?
d6c12e10eed3e05410156afa7e9e814e2dc7b879.tgt: Solve by iteration `T(n)=T(n/2)+n²`. What is the adjusted order?

a529e49a9cbd8906751646a4a39237d01540490e.src: `T(n)=T(1)+n²+n²/4+n²/16+...`. La razón geométrica es `1/4`, así que la suma total es `Θ(n²)`.
a529e49a9cbd8906751646a4a39237d01540490e.tgt: `T(n)=T(1)+n²+n²/4+n²/16+...`. The geometric ratio is `1/4`, so the total sum is `Θ(n²)`.

2d0015587f0e8970372faf4e91321401265ee4bc.src: Correcto. La expansión produce `n² + (n/2)² + (n/4)² + ...`, una serie geométrica dominada por `n²`.
2d0015587f0e8970372faf4e91321401265ee4bc.tgt: Correct. The expansion produces `n² + (n/2)² + (n/4)² + ...`, a geometric series dominated by `n²`.

5ac37d92165cff42dd58e22e60ed0c7e64872708.src: Incorrecto. El primer término acumulado ya es `n²`, así que no puede ser lineal.
5ac37d92165cff42dd58e22e60ed0c7e64872708.tgt: Incorrect. The first accumulated term is already `n²`, so it cannot be linear.

e09d9623ca2da8aa911748c9375a9d08ea0610fd.src: Incorrecto. El trabajo por nivel disminuye geométricamente; no permanece en `n²` durante `log n` niveles.
e09d9623ca2da8aa911748c9375a9d08ea0610fd.tgt: Wrong. The work per level decreases geometrically; does not stay at `n²` during `log n` levels.

c6b31dc1157df4629161471ad1fc208142edfb6f.src: Incorrecto. Aunque hay `log n` niveles, el costo acumulado está dominado por el término cuadrático inicial.
c6b31dc1157df4629161471ad1fc208142edfb6f.tgt: Wrong. Although there are `log n` levels, the cumulative cost is dominated by the initial quadratic term.

a9a7763a9fd6c6f16f2a7549437cbad9b0369b33.src: ¿Cuándo conviene usar el método de iteración en lugar de aplicar mecánicamente el Teorema Maestro? Selecciona todas las afirmaciones correctas.
a9a7763a9fd6c6f16f2a7549437cbad9b0369b33.tgt: When is it convenient to use the iteration method instead of mechanically applying the Master Theorem? Select all the correct statements.

de1a52803b0105b076248ce181dd067193df0d72.src: El método de iteración es útil cuando la forma no encaja en una plantilla directa o cuando se quiere ver la acumulación del costo paso a paso. No elimina la necesidad de justificar el análisis.
de1a52803b0105b076248ce181dd067193df0d72.tgt: The iteration method is useful when the shape does not fit a direct template or when you want to see the cost accumulation step by step. It does not eliminate the need to justify the analysis.

e18df31028af91a3507d2b63ae8cc6c5b355ca55.src: Cuando la recurrencia no tiene la forma estándar `T(n)=aT(n/b)+f(n)`.
e18df31028af91a3507d2b63ae8cc6c5b355ca55.tgt: When the recurrence does not have the standard form `T(n)=aT(n/b)+f(n)`.

333b99fba6e3d8500095acbfc862441682dbb313.src: Correcto. Si la forma no coincide con el Teorema Maestro, iterar puede ser una alternativa más segura.
333b99fba6e3d8500095acbfc862441682dbb313.tgt: Correct. If the form does not match the Master Theorem, iterating may be a safer alternative.

e6a7720ecdc84a2433632ea29d21db922928b166.src: Cuando se quiere entender explícitamente cómo se acumula el costo en cada expansión.
e6a7720ecdc84a2433632ea29d21db922928b166.tgt: When you want to explicitly understand how the cost accumulates in each expansion.

71dc3d0c6c89933411203802cd7ed01bf63927a3.src: Correcto. La iteración es pedagógicamente útil porque muestra de dónde sale la suma final.
71dc3d0c6c89933411203802cd7ed01bf63927a3.tgt: Correct. Iteration is pedagogically useful because it shows where the final sum comes from.

1597281da90e0fabcda3945ae6087e6a4eee4144.src: Cuando la recurrencia reduce por resta, como `T(n)=T(n-1)+f(n)`.
1597281da90e0fabcda3945ae6087e6a4eee4144.tgt: When recurrence reduces by subtraction, such as `T(n)=T(n-1)+f(n)`.

65a83d922f5f067ebf6174ab008a072d046bfc1e.src: Correcto. Las reducciones por resta suelen resolverse naturalmente expandiendo hasta el caso base.
65a83d922f5f067ebf6174ab008a072d046bfc1e.tgt: Correct. Subtraction reductions are usually solved naturally by expanding to the base case.

cdfd40518f745d315c0e3999865dbecbf7afece5.src: Cuando no se quiere justificar ningún paso matemático.
cdfd40518f745d315c0e3999865dbecbf7afece5.tgt: When you don't want to justify any mathematical step.

8f133b6823125447754f7a1056b76c8c75b9dfc5.src: Incorrecto. El método de iteración exige justificar expansión, patrón, parada y simplificación.
8f133b6823125447754f7a1056b76c8c75b9dfc5.tgt: Wrong. The iteration method requires justifying expansion, pattern, stopping and simplification.

91a01002002a5665e0bdf85beacca75bf02375c4.src: ¿Para qué tipo de recurrencias está diseñado el Teorema Maestro en su forma clásica?
91a01002002a5665e0bdf85beacca75bf02375c4.tgt: What type of recurrences is the Master Theorem in its classical form designed for?

d7abdb69d28b4324948a87c2c22fc43f36e91b83.src: La forma clásica requiere identificar `a`, `b` y `f(n)` en `T(n)=aT(n/b)+f(n)`. Si la recurrencia no tiene esa estructura, aplicar el teorema mecánicamente es un error.
d7abdb69d28b4324948a87c2c22fc43f36e91b83.tgt: The classical way requires identifying `a`, `b` and `f(n)` in `T(n)=aT(n/b)+f(n)`. If the recurrence does not have that structure, applying the theorem mechanically is a mistake.

20177a34d131b62e2d25d6afa2a8db48ff4ecaac.src: Para recurrencias de la forma `T(n)=aT(n/b)+f(n)`, con subproblemas del mismo tamaño y trabajo adicional `f(n)`.
20177a34d131b62e2d25d6afa2a8db48ff4ecaac.tgt: For recurrences of the form `T(n)=aT(n/b)+f(n)`, with subproblems of the same size and additional work `f(n)`.

fa0b0bf347a64f6309ca13e66c857b13f288f27c.src: Correcto. El Teorema Maestro compara `f(n)` contra `n^log_b(a)` en recurrencias balanceadas de esa forma.
fa0b0bf347a64f6309ca13e66c857b13f288f27c.tgt: Correct. The Master Theorem compares `f(n)` against `n^log_b(a)` in balanced recurrences in this way.

222f6a938d74bd883a986cf695f5134f6b49d02c.src: Para cualquier recurrencia, incluso si tiene subproblemas `T(n-1)` o tamaños distintos como `T(n/2)+T(n/3)`.
222f6a938d74bd883a986cf695f5134f6b49d02c.tgt: Para cualquier recurrencia, incluso si tiene subproblemas `T(n-1)` o tamaños distintos como `T(n/2)+T(n/3)`.

50c856a873b8ee70b276e0487d780f1a2e536572.src: Incorrecto. La forma clásica no aplica automáticamente a reducciones por resta ni a subproblemas de tamaños diferentes.
50c856a873b8ee70b276e0487d780f1a2e536572.tgt: Wrong. The classical form does not automatically apply to reductions by subtraction or to subproblems of different sizes.

549dd250aef425384bcde69a89ef809d18eedad0.src: Solo para algoritmos iterativos con un único ciclo `FOR`.
549dd250aef425384bcde69a89ef809d18eedad0.tgt: Only for iterative algorithms with a single `FOR` cycle.

65fd61256d0e0915327c8de8e384221e08c00a01.src: Incorrecto. El Teorema Maestro se usa para recurrencias, típicamente surgidas de algoritmos recursivos.
65fd61256d0e0915327c8de8e384221e08c00a01.tgt: Wrong. The Master Theorem is used for recurrences, typically arising from recursive algorithms.

fc1cbe6a4d018739c099a5e5219f16aa7204a0e1.src: Solo para medir el tiempo real de ejecución en una máquina.
fc1cbe6a4d018739c099a5e5219f16aa7204a0e1.tgt: Just to measure the actual execution time on a machine.

646dfc7ca5996c5f74c83abba4121fe0ccdb10f4.src: Incorrecto. Es una herramienta matemática de análisis asintótico, no una técnica de medición experimental.
646dfc7ca5996c5f74c83abba4121fe0ccdb10f4.tgt: Wrong. It is a mathematical tool of asymptotic analysis, not an experimental measurement technique.

fa35501908d684df705830ddad4005051c4f546b.src: En la recurrencia `T(n)=3T(n/2)+n`, ¿cuáles son los valores de `a`, `b` y `f(n)`?
fa35501908d684df705830ddad4005051c4f546b.tgt: In recurrence `T(n)=3T(n/2)+n`, what are the values of `a`, `b`, and `f(n)`?

269b365281875fd08c28f95bde90ca6e5faa592a.src: La forma `aT(n/b)+f(n)` permite leer directamente los parámetros: `a=3`, `b=2` y `f(n)=n`.
269b365281875fd08c28f95bde90ca6e5faa592a.tgt: The `aT(n/b)+f(n)` form allows you to directly read the parameters: `a=3`, `b=2` and `f(n)=n`.

f16f689db5756f4bf5b08fda69c204a4f01f8e90.src: Correcto. Hay tres subproblemas de tamaño `n/2` y trabajo adicional lineal.
f16f689db5756f4bf5b08fda69c204a4f01f8e90.tgt: Correct. There are three subproblems of size `n/2` and linear additional work.

6fcacccafb09b7d52c8688bead54a42a8587d57a.src: Incorrecto. El coeficiente de `T` es `a=3`, y el divisor dentro del argumento es `b=2`.
6fcacccafb09b7d52c8688bead54a42a8587d57a.tgt: Wrong. The coefficient of `T` is `a=3`, and the divisor within the argument is `b=2`.

ed180edac9faf5af665f132395e4ae17d2b9ae11.src: Incorrecto. `a` es el número de subproblemas, no el tamaño de entrada.
ed180edac9faf5af665f132395e4ae17d2b9ae11.tgt: Wrong. `a` is the number of subproblems, not the input size.

589bf227c94f7c3c14601d6ce045e8112207e963.src: Incorrecto. `b` sale de `n/2`; por tanto `b=2`, no `n`.

912cf418278bada8878829a99c40e94b2d264a0f.src: En el Teorema Maestro, ¿qué representa la función crítica `n^log_b(a)`?
912cf418278bada8878829a99c40e94b2d264a0f.tgt: In the Master Theorem, what does the critical function `n^log_b(a)` represent?

dce79a673b40b06b50f2741a421b7e258375c732.src: Para decidir el caso del Teorema Maestro, se compara `f(n)` con `n^log_b(a)`. Esa comparación determina qué parte domina el costo total.
dce79a673b40b06b50f2741a421b7e258375c732.tgt: To decide the case of the Master Theorem, compare `f(n)` with `n^log_b(a)`. That comparison determines which part dominates the total cost.

9130b8f9fec4b477880dc84b90a0727aa619c294.src: El crecimiento asociado al número de subproblemas y a la reducción de tamaño, contra el cual se compara `f(n)`.
9130b8f9fec4b477880dc84b90a0727aa619c294.tgt: The growth associated with the number of subproblems and the reduction in size, against which `f(n)` is compared.

32c0771b769338c75ba03d777b692dada4e9b7cb.src: Correcto. Esa función marca el umbral entre dominio del árbol recursivo y dominio del trabajo adicional.
32c0771b769338c75ba03d777b692dada4e9b7cb.tgt: Correct. That function marks the threshold between domain of the recursive tree and domain of additional work.

1cf23616f8d980cb79a07ed1ba3045bc9c6f5db3.src: El costo exacto de cada comparación elemental en memoria RAM.
1cf23616f8d980cb79a07ed1ba3045bc9c6f5db3.tgt: The exact cost of each elemental comparison in RAM.

09b61815e404c5978eb19b076219bb83e8e9c839.src: Incorrecto. No es una operación elemental; es una función de crecimiento derivada de `a` y `b`.
09b61815e404c5978eb19b076219bb83e8e9c839.tgt: Wrong. It is not an elementary operation; is a growth function derived from `a` and `b`.

dc73c47ffcd2cf79791da2d9524cd8f3c1618ed1.src: El caso base de la recurrencia.

4a2e4e7c9664c5cecf213d21651cd2b29debfd45.src: Incorrecto. El caso base detiene la recursión; `n^log_b(a)` sirve para comparar tasas de crecimiento.
4a2e4e7c9664c5cecf213d21651cd2b29debfd45.tgt: Wrong. The base case stops the recursion; `n^log_b(a)` is used to compare growth rates.

6b3fe27c68674343eab50e5670aa546f57042d64.src: El número exacto de líneas del pseudocódigo.
6b3fe27c68674343eab50e5670aa546f57042d64.tgt: The exact number of lines of the pseudocode.

6dc1c2883076652db205c630bb8984f163ff3925.src: Incorrecto. El Teorema Maestro no depende del número textual de líneas, sino de la estructura de la recurrencia.
6dc1c2883076652db205c630bb8984f163ff3925.tgt: Wrong. The Master Theorem does not depend on the textual number of lines, but on the structure of the recurrence.

e1dbd8d9652351ff1c0515d506c5a453e1f246e8.src: En el caso 1 del Teorema Maestro, si `p=log_b(a)`, ¿qué debe cumplirse con `f(n)`?
e1dbd8d9652351ff1c0515d506c5a453e1f246e8.tgt: In case 1 of the Master Theorem, if `p=log_b(a)`, what must be true of `f(n)`?

f0255fd25b334fdb5e4ba1617f78b520c2904a65.src: El caso 1 exige una separación polinómica: `f(n)` queda por debajo de `n^p` como máximo en `n^(p-ε)`, donde `ε` es positivo.
f0255fd25b334fdb5e4ba1617f78b520c2904a65.tgt: Case 1 requires a polynomial separation: `f(n)` falls below `n^p` at most at `n^(p-ε)`, where `ε` is positive.

892089e9a23b34e22cafa06736b0c4c7c45680bc.src: `f(n)` debe ser asintóticamente menor que `n^p` por un factor polinómico: `f(n) ∈ O(n^(p-ε))` para algún `ε > 0`.
892089e9a23b34e22cafa06736b0c4c7c45680bc.tgt: `f(n)` must be asymptotically less than `n^p` by a polynomial factor: `f(n) ∈ O(n^(p-ε))` for some `ε > 0`.

8daa415f1dde2d36accbcce63cf67fae8c3a66d3.src: Correcto. No basta con decir que es “un poco menor”; debe existir una brecha polinómica positiva.
8daa415f1dde2d36accbcce63cf67fae8c3a66d3.tgt: Correct. It is not enough to say that it is “a little less”; there must be a positive polynomial gap.

bc70f3ace53653da292db41b60593dad9b62f1d7.src: `f(n)` debe ser exactamente igual a `n^p` para todo `n`.
bc70f3ace53653da292db41b60593dad9b62f1d7.tgt: `f(n)` must be exactly the same as `n^p` for all `n`.

6f8ad239ca43658bf36e88ae7fa88317ec6912f6.src: Incorrecto. Eso corresponde a la intuición del caso 2, no del caso 1.
6f8ad239ca43658bf36e88ae7fa88317ec6912f6.tgt: Wrong. That corresponds to the intuition of case 2, not case 1.

8f78a6776680a495f82300ad2630bc88bd6f975f.src: `f(n)` debe ser mayor que `n^p` por un factor polinómico.
8f78a6776680a495f82300ad2630bc88bd6f975f.tgt: `f(n)` must be greater than `n^p` by a polynomial factor.

3e015a9ee7515893029a26e8ac9e77c57b4f6ef8.src: Incorrecto. Eso apunta al caso 3, no al caso 1.
3e015a9ee7515893029a26e8ac9e77c57b4f6ef8.tgt: Wrong. That points to case 3, not case 1.

5a1300d7fa826236c0c3412041606ca0a115e300.src: `f(n)` debe ser siempre constante, sin excepción.
5a1300d7fa826236c0c3412041606ca0a115e300.tgt: `f(n)` must always be constant, without exception.

23f5c1f563f8b9a3d945520d5a80348b00f9dd76.src: Incorrecto. Puede ser constante en algunos ejemplos, pero el caso 1 permite funciones menores que `n^p` por una brecha polinómica.
23f5c1f563f8b9a3d945520d5a80348b00f9dd76.tgt: Incorrect. It may be constant in some examples, but case 1 allows functions smaller than `n^p` by a polynomial gap.

2e5f166b5ab336af76b396e5875ede4dc35f56bb.src: En el caso 2 del Teorema Maestro en su forma básica, ¿qué relación debe existir entre `f(n)` y `n^log_b(a)`?
2e5f166b5ab336af76b396e5875ede4dc35f56bb.tgt: In case 2 of the Master Theorem in its basic form, what relationship must exist between `f(n)` and `n^log_b(a)`?

c21472e55f3b75c071a93f633d453d318d725ffb.src: Cuando `f(n)` empata con la función crítica, el resultado básico es `Θ(n^log_b(a) log n)`.
c21472e55f3b75c071a93f633d453d318d725ffb.tgt: When `f(n)` matches the critical function, the basic result is `Θ(n^log_b(a) log n)`.

21f1f43480075af77576c3e08c79f10070a4e290.src: Correcto. En el caso 2, el trabajo adicional y la función crítica tienen el mismo orden.
21f1f43480075af77576c3e08c79f10070a4e290.tgt: Correct. In case 2, the additional work and the critical function have the same order.

4e29be9f08b8d945096462a9970e263dbb006e43.src: `f(n)` debe ser menor por una brecha polinómica.
4e29be9f08b8d945096462a9970e263dbb006e43.tgt: `f(n)` must be smaller by a polynomial gap.

2050d2e9aace40762b770656552fcf60a227d1ed.src: Incorrecto. Esa es la condición del caso 1.
2050d2e9aace40762b770656552fcf60a227d1ed.tgt: Wrong. That is the condition of case 1.

cc1f9821ce42dc330d51290ae8697496b9daab48.src: `f(n)` debe ser mayor por una brecha polinómica y cumplir regularidad.
cc1f9821ce42dc330d51290ae8697496b9daab48.tgt: `f(n)` must be greater by a polynomial gap and satisfy regularity.

742e3342a6977149127db02d5ce96f9adafd8463.src: Incorrecto. Esa es la idea del caso 3.
742e3342a6977149127db02d5ce96f9adafd8463.tgt: Wrong. That's the idea of case 3.

4bb1b7f694278644b2d46bbff77cdaad4d0e2016.src: Incorrecto. El caso 2 depende de la función crítica; no exige que `f(n)` sea constante.
4bb1b7f694278644b2d46bbff77cdaad4d0e2016.tgt: Wrong. Case 2 depends on the critical function; does not require that `f(n)` be constant.

ddcae0f8575f04f7e1c477f5a6cf28b2bf5d9746.src: En el caso 3 del Teorema Maestro, además de que `f(n)` sea mayor que `n^p` por una brecha polinómica, ¿qué condición adicional suele exigirse?
ddcae0f8575f04f7e1c477f5a6cf28b2bf5d9746.tgt: In case 3 of the Master Theorem, in addition to `f(n)` being greater than `n^p` by a polynomial gap, what additional condition is usually required?

58d8abf5a5a7b6ea12a725a3199f7ede7d393b00.src: El caso 3 no se activa solo porque `f(n)` parezca mayor. También se exige una condición que garantice que el trabajo de los subproblemas no compite de forma irregular contra `f(n)`.
58d8abf5a5a7b6ea12a725a3199f7ede7d393b00.tgt: Case 3 is not triggered just because `f(n)` appears larger. A condition is also required to ensure that the work of the subproblems does not compete irregularly against `f(n)`.

ed7f96f896b478e6e1385b6d4daab39b21ced6fe.src: Una condición de regularidad, por ejemplo que `a f(n/b) ≤ c f(n)` para alguna constante `c < 1` y `n` suficientemente grande.
ed7f96f896b478e6e1385b6d4daab39b21ced6fe.tgt: A regularity condition, for example that `a f(n/b) ≤ c f(n)` for some sufficiently large constant `c < 1` and `n`.

b6463151e277d9b37930b049e3f23967de47a86f.src: Correcto. Esa condición evita aplicar el caso 3 a funciones con comportamiento irregular donde la conclusión no está justificada.
b6463151e277d9b37930b049e3f23967de47a86f.tgt: Correct. This condition avoids applying case 3 to functions with irregular behavior where the conclusion is not justified.

8df133cc2b88f819b7865a6a73fdcc07bf3b5bf3.src: Incorrecto. En el caso 3, `f(n)` suele ser la parte dominante, no necesariamente constante.
8df133cc2b88f819b7865a6a73fdcc07bf3b5bf3.tgt: Wrong. In case 3, `f(n)` is usually the dominant part, not necessarily constant.

6fda885a9c17a1cd3255f7b8541286fdf689703a.src: Que `a=0` y no existan llamadas recursivas.
6fda885a9c17a1cd3255f7b8541286fdf689703a.tgt: That `a=0` and there are no recursive calls.

b3beeba35bdcb579a739d4f3fb538447824def8b.src: Incorrecto. El Teorema Maestro trata recurrencias con llamadas recursivas; `a` representa su cantidad.
b3beeba35bdcb579a739d4f3fb538447824def8b.tgt: Wrong. The Master Theorem treats recurrences with recursive calls; `a` represents its quantity.

c5c71a8fb8d6f5377fa41cf96bed7f9d3938a782.src: Incorrecto. Eso corresponde al caso 1, no al caso 3.
c5c71a8fb8d6f5377fa41cf96bed7f9d3938a782.tgt: Wrong. That corresponds to case 1, not case 3.

0bb611c582476c8e718532345a9a78f9d5f987c5.src: Porque `n^p/log n` es menor que `n^p`, pero no por una brecha polinómica `n^(p-ε)`.

9c0d7ec1b1735aeacd1eab1706027f98123c640d.tgt: The height is obtained by solving for `n/2^h = 1`. Hence `2^h=n` and therefore `h=log₂ n`.

4a8cb86539dd3e4de7f62ece62a94c64d75c1b7b.src: `log₂ n`, porque el tamaño se divide entre 2 en cada nivel.
4a8cb86539dd3e4de7f62ece62a94c64d75c1b7b.tgt: `log₂ n`, because the size is divided by 2 at each level.

373c79b3026e87c7e3b70e2618fe92af42a3add2.src: Correcto. Después de `h` niveles el tamaño es `n/2^h`; se llega a 1 cuando `h=log₂ n`.
373c79b3026e87c7e3b70e2618fe92af42a3add2.tgt: Correct. After `h` levels the size is `n/2^h`; 1 is reached when `h=log₂ n`.

73ffa3ac14f52011b7c08663df573f173323c114.src: `n`, porque hay dos llamadas en cada nivel.
73ffa3ac14f52011b7c08663df573f173323c114.tgt: `n`, because there are two calls at each level.

7c5a57c44ac03df7b630ab4bff869e4ac98e8700.src: Incorrecto. Las dos llamadas afectan la cantidad de nodos por nivel, no la altura cuando cada tamaño se divide entre 2.
7c5a57c44ac03df7b630ab4bff869e4ac98e8700.tgt: Wrong. The two calls affect the number of nodes per level, not the height when each size is divided by 2.

30bf13ecc6e83ef5a38b6c32d48709e12fe7e090.src: `n²`, porque la recurrencia tiene dos subproblemas.

c4d0ed6a6f56b66985f43bfd37cc783075c03454.src: Incorrecto. La altura no es cuadrática; se determina por la reducción de tamaño del subproblema.
c4d0ed6a6f56b66985f43bfd37cc783075c03454.tgt: Wrong. Height is not quadratic; It is determined by the size reduction of the subproblem.

d0dc636095f99e7c7109567be7464788a1e2565d.src: `1`, porque el árbol empieza con una raíz.
d0dc636095f99e7c7109567be7464788a1e2565d.tgt: `1`, because the tree begins with a root.

0bf738f559f255a6815231af49eab4bfed35bf87.tgt: Wrong. Just because there is a root does not mean that the tree has only one level.

5f644e82cc464b0e9f58341fd7a9426a2e104823.src: En `T(n)=2T(n/2)+n`, ¿cuál es el costo total del nivel `i` del árbol de recursión?
5f644e82cc464b0e9f58341fd7a9426a2e104823.tgt: At `T(n)=2T(n/2)+n`, what is the total cost of the `i` level of the recursion tree?

043747c40c8b76f4ddfd1c22faafb3ee2716d636.tgt: At level `i`, the tree has `2^i` nodes. Each node processes a subproblem of size `n/2^i`, so the total cost of the level is `n`.

c35525cbb5859ed355255f14590414c289ed4343.src: `n`, porque hay `2^i` nodos de tamaño `n/2^i`, y cada uno aporta `n/2^i`.
c35525cbb5859ed355255f14590414c289ed4343.tgt: `n`, because there are `2^i` nodes of size `n/2^i`, and each one contributes `n/2^i`.

1de9990454a54f0bbf627f517d00ff134ead143a.src: Correcto. El costo total del nivel es `2^i · (n/2^i) = n`.
1de9990454a54f0bbf627f517d00ff134ead143a.tgt: Correct. The total cost of the level is `2^i · (n/2^i) = n`.

ac2077123328b47d256a5a871ef78d8faebbd238.src: `n/2^i`, porque solo importa el tamaño de un nodo.
ac2077123328b47d256a5a871ef78d8faebbd238.tgt: `n/2^i`, because only the size of a node matters.

ceccf39277c10121c1dded35e5f520fff5e62e56.src: Incorrecto. Hay que multiplicar el costo de un nodo por la cantidad de nodos del nivel.
ceccf39277c10121c1dded35e5f520fff5e62e56.tgt: Wrong. You must multiply the cost of a node by the number of nodes in the level.

31176d128e933c7d1e2aa2459d0ad107e7bdd500.src: `2^i`, porque solo importa el número de nodos.
31176d128e933c7d1e2aa2459d0ad107e7bdd500.tgt: `2^i`, because only the number of nodes matters.

0498b02fd59c892dc04543033d9a660fe1f6f2fe.src: Incorrecto. También importa el costo local de cada nodo.
0498b02fd59c892dc04543033d9a660fe1f6f2fe.tgt: Wrong. The local cost of each node also matters.

ed020d8be2f891389d41ad349631d48bf0ec9d10.src: `n²`, porque toda recurrencia con dos ramas es cuadrática.
ed020d8be2f891389d41ad349631d48bf0ec9d10.tgt: `n²`, because every recurrence with two branches is quadratic.

24d053eacbf27ad3c941bb5bc6a95c77dc127ad0.src: Incorrecto. La ramificación por sí sola no determina costo cuadrático.
24d053eacbf27ad3c941bb5bc6a95c77dc127ad0.tgt: Wrong. Branching alone does not determine quadratic cost.

5c88b31cd6d3ae8225a8f132b402eee6f65b8ae7.src: Usando árbol de recursión, ¿cuál es el orden ajustado de `T(n)=2T(n/2)+n`?
5c88b31cd6d3ae8225a8f132b402eee6f65b8ae7.tgt: Using recursion tree, what is the adjusted order of `T(n)=2T(n/2)+n`?

2d8dfe964c3c3cd5f19eb6a0270de486de7f6fc2.tgt: Each level provides `Θ(n)`, and there are `Θ(log n)` levels until reaching subproblems of size 1. Total: `Θ(n log n)`.

e4bf2124c6b6ff35b4aac37b6c98ffd06ac7b2b1.tgt: Correct. There are `log n` levels and each level costs `n`.

3a01b55a8c57dda7566b302d53077f89c973115c.tgt: Incorrect. It remains to multiply the linear cost by the logarithmic number of levels.

f1984aed575c51a3d88e96d967be1c4c0dcf1dae.src: Incorrecto. La altura es logarítmica, pero cada nivel cuesta `n`.
f1984aed575c51a3d88e96d967be1c4c0dcf1dae.tgt: Wrong. The height is logarithmic, but each level costs `n`.

74f7f3f3cc7aa82f53dd5dcbbcecbb7c04ff0a17.tgt: Wrong. The cost per level does not grow to quadratic; remains linear.

0ffde80536cdacc79097ae04c741f7db02c001e1.tgt: In `T(n)=T(n/2)+n`, what shape is the recursion tree?

d5096f77450802009b15abd90c9a44db9f26d7af.src: La recurrencia tiene una única llamada por nivel. El tamaño se reduce a la mitad, y el trabajo local forma una serie geométrica decreciente.
d5096f77450802009b15abd90c9a44db9f26d7af.tgt: Recurrence has a single call per level. The size is reduced by half, and the local work forms a decreasing geometric series.

136642ce9920dc61f2914be054cda548a3669629.src: Una sola rama por nivel, con costos `n`, `n/2`, `n/4`, ...
136642ce9920dc61f2914be054cda548a3669629.tgt: A single branch per level, with costs `n`, `n/2`, `n/4`, ...

589ada4bb3865f652a84e9e73e530d2055a1bd44.tgt: Correct. Since there is only one recursive call, there is no multiple branching.

c99fab4bbdffa9049ea0034dd844f877e1dc8469.tgt: The tree has one branch per level. The total cost is `n+n/2+n/4+...`, which adds up to an amount proportional to `n`.

5909bf6950a5762af916668fce2f5a2f9926baa1.tgt: Wrong. The decreasing geometric series does not produce quadratic growth.

07a176ce2cbb7386b96c0f14efc12777b0b4df5b.tgt: Level `i` has `8^i` nodes. Each node costs `(n/2^i)^2`. The product is `8^i·n²/4^i = n²·2^i`, so the cost increases by level.

ca714d89981ce20b1b012097b4e9bbed4fff9d41.src: Crece geométricamente: en el nivel `i` vale `n²·2^i`.
ca714d89981ce20b1b012097b4e9bbed4fff9d41.tgt: It grows geometrically: at the level `i` it is worth `n²·2^i`.

1a6cac6fb96e170ec8c8f84e128fa8bed6a9ec3f.tgt: Correct. There are `8^i` nodes, each of size `n/2^i`, with local cost `(n/2^i)²`; total: `8^i·n²/4^i = n²·2^i`.

1afe646175eb9245ca33fb0cd3bfaf56ad619957.src: Permanece constante en `n²` para todos los niveles.

711a072db0f16ef371946f0245b8cdb0b7d0ed84.src: Incorrecto. Eso ocurriría en una recurrencia como `4T(n/2)+n²`, no con `8T(n/2)+n²`.

d3f65f7d8401194f1ff14946ff9d77f6bf5cbdec.src: Correcto. Cada nodo genera `a` hijos, así que la cantidad se multiplica por `a` en cada nivel.
d3f65f7d8401194f1ff14946ff9d77f6bf5cbdec.tgt: Correct. Each node generates `a` children, so the amount is multiplied by `a` at each level.

a9b6bb0a641e1418f474c40012f789e1b0019f9e.src: Incorrecto. `b` controla la reducción del tamaño, no la cantidad de hijos.
a9b6bb0a641e1418f474c40012f789e1b0019f9e.tgt: Wrong. `b` controls size reduction, not number of children.

492b8c90ec43307c7510b900c09c076c8ebcd0c0.tgt: Correct. At each level the size is divided by `b`, so after `i` levels it is `n/b^i`.
